summary.name: Chalk on Black Paper
summary.visualIdentity: Powdery chalk marks on a dark black paper field, with broken, textured edges and layered opaque and pale strokes. The dark paper must stay visible; this differs from charcoal on light paper. Strokes are rendered per-dab with seeded grain and paper-tooth gaps. Provenance is extracted, added in the 2026-10-12 sync.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: sketch-style scenes where chalk marks build up over time, such as annotated subjects, boxed callouts, and arrowed diagrams. Inferred: instructional videos and interactive HTML that benefit from a hand-drawn, progressively drawn look. Not verified for photographic or highly detailed realistic content.
summary.limitations: Dab counts must stay bounded, roughly 30–60k per frame, which constrains stroke density. The style is two-color by design, so accent hues are not licensed. Text placement must be checked in composited frames, since the two-color contrast check does not cover textures or video. The poster shows a dark fog scene, so the exact background hex is a fallback. Full per-frame rebuilds may slow dense scenes.
summary.palette: Background: #15141A, an opaque dark paper field and the single dominant scene background. Foreground: #F1EBDD, the chalk color for pale and opaque strokes and text. Foreground on background contrast is 15.405:1, meeting the 4.5 normal-text target for opaque captions only. Pale passes use about 0.35 alpha and opaque accents about 0.9. No gradient is enabled. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Strokes draw progressively through GSAP tweens of per-stroke progress values on a paused, seekable timeline. Arrow heads appear only after shaft samples reach the endpoint. Text inside boxes reveals after the box stroke completes. Each frame is rebuilt from scratch, so backward and direct seeks are exact. No motion reference candidates are specified. Deliberate holds for reading should be preserved.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source. Inferred suitability: restrained ambience or light sound effects could mark drawing actions and reading holds, and voiceover could explain the topic. Speech must stay intelligible and must not compete with narration. The source does not specify music genre, tempo, sung vocals, or any mandatory audio layer.
summary.assetRequirements: No external image or font assets are specified. The implementation generates a static black-paper tooth texture once into an offscreen canvas from seeded noise2D. Stroke paths are authored and sampled at fixed arc-length steps. Local fonts must load before rendering. Any audio assets are unspecified and must be sourced separately.
summary.combinations: Keep Chalk on Black Paper dominant. A secondary style is suggested only when the brief benefits from it. The suggested supporting style is style-030 for original narrative staging, which must not replace the background or import its palette. Keep one coherent geometry and material system, and avoid competing full-scene treatments or decorative motion.
summary.productionApproach: Canvas 2D is the style renderer on an opaque #15141A field, drawing #F1EBDD dabs along cached stroke paths with seeded noise grain. GSAP is the motion engine, owning per-stroke progress. HyperFrames is the default render pipeline for timing, validation, and export; Remotion is only a conditional fallback for a verified limitation. Verify decoded frames, audio sync, and loop continuity before delivery.
